texts.preamble: Raghvendra Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 February, 2020 Author: Anand Pathak Bench: Anand Pathak 1 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Criminal Revision No.701/2020 (Raghvendra Singh Kushwaha Vs. State of M.P.) Gwalior, dated : 13.02.2020
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that trial court as well as appellate court erred in convicting the applicant and awarding the jail sentence to the revisionist under the provisions of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954. At this stage, Shri Pateria, Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant fairly submitted that being guided by spirit of community service performed by litigants/accused of the High Court whereby they are performing community service by way of Plantation/Hospital Service/Blood Donation/Installation of Water Harvesting System. He also undertakes to perform community service as a counsel and therefore, submitted that he intends to open up Peoples Provident Fund Account (P.P.F.) of his junior colleagues and to maintain it to the best of his ability. Therefore, he seeks reiteration of the said spirit in the order.
